ui.chat.empty: Say something to {agent}. The answer appears here, and the work behind it is under Work.
ui.chat.hint.desktop: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line
ui.chat.hint.phone: Enter breaks the line, the button sends
ui.chat.noPersona.body: This workspace has no persona yet, so there is nobody to talk to here. Make one in Settings, or look at the Overview.
ui.chat.noPersona.title: No persona yet
ui.chat.queued: Waiting for the answer before this one
ui.chat.willWait: An answer is going. What you write now waits its turn.
ui.chat.work.label: Work
ui.nav.chat.live: Chat, a ceremony is in progress
ui.overview.title: Overview
ui.persona.f.instructionsHint: About you: who you are, how you decide, what matters to you and what you never want done. They are part of everything the persona answers.
ui.persona.f.jobHint: One sentence on what the persona is for you.
ui.persona.f.name: Name
ui.persona.section.clear.body: The messages, their files and the memory this conversation made are deleted. The persona stays as it is.
ui.persona.section.clear.title: Clear the conversation with the persona?
ui.persona.section.delete.body: The persona and its conversation (messages, files and memory) are deleted. You can make another with the wizard.
ui.persona.section.delete.title: Delete the persona?
ui.persona.section.draft: A persona draft was left by an earlier session. It is not your persona and nothing uses it.
ui.persona.section.draft.body: The draft and its test conversation are deleted.
ui.persona.section.draft.title: Discard the persona draft?
ui.persona.section.intro: Your persona is your representative in the app: you chat with it, and it can take you to a screen. For now it can read, chat and offer buttons that open a screen, and nothing else.
ui.persona.section.none: This workspace has no persona yet. The AI asks a few questions about you, writes a draft and lets you try it in a chat.
ui.persona.section.readNote: These texts are read by the model of its provider, kept in this computer's session files, and can be read from a paired browser.
ui.persona.section.title: Persona
ui.persona.wizard.close.bodyDraft: Your answers are lost, and the test draft and its conversation are deleted.
ui.persona.wizard.close.title: Close the wizard?
ui.persona.wizard.enough: The AI says it has nothing more to ask. Finish to review the draft.
ui.persona.wizard.intro: The AI asks about you, writes a draft of your persona and lets you try it in a chat. Nothing becomes your persona until you save it.
ui.persona.wizard.request.adjust: What do you want to change?
ui.persona.wizard.request.create: Who are you, and what do you do?
ui.persona.wizard.request.placeholderAdj: E.g. blunter answers, and never schedule anything on Fridays
ui.persona.wizard.request.placeholderCre: E.g. I lead a team of five; I decide fast on small things and slowly on anything that touches production
ui.persona.wizard.review.can: For now your persona can read, chat with you and open screens for you. It cannot change anything, run commands or use tools.
ui.persona.wizard.review.hint: Edit whatever you like: these three texts are your persona.
ui.persona.wizard.review.next: Try the draft in a chat, or save it now. Nothing is your persona until you save.
ui.persona.wizard.screen.lead: Your persona is your representative in the app. It takes a few minutes: the AI asks, you answer, and you try it before it is saved.
ui.persona.wizard.screen.title: Let's make your persona
ui.persona.wizard.test.hint: This is the real draft, with no tools here, so nothing said in this test changes anything. Write the way you would in your real conversation.
ui.persona.wizard.test.noRounds: All {max} rounds are used. Go back to the review, or save the draft as it is.
